text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That outfit isn't bad either, but... adding a stronger accent color would give it more flair. Make the skirt red to add a pop of color!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: Ooh... King-sensei! Thank you so much for your first-class fashion check!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! It is nothing for one such as myself! Now, who wishes to have their fashion evaluated next?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Sensei! I'd like some advice too, if that's okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Oh my, Tannhauser-san. Do you also desire a fashion check from King?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes! The truth is... I have someone I'd love for you to make shine with your sense of style, King-chan.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Eh? Someone you want me to dress up... wait, what!?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Tada! A "kaiju figure"! Its name is the Nap Monster, "Guutara"! Those giant lips are so cute, ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: I think it's super adorable, but nobody else really seems to get it.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: So please, with King-chan's sense of style, please dress this little guy up so that everyone can see how cute it is~~!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: No, but... this is utterly unprecedented, or rather, this isn't even fashion...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hmm, is it too hard after all? If even King-chan can't do it, I guess I'll just have to give up...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: .........I did not say I was "giving up"!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Leave this request to King! I shall accomplish it to absolute perfection!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Though I declared as much, just how on earth am I supposed to make this fuzzball cute...?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (The fashion sense I have cultivated will not suffice here. In that case, I must first learn about figures themselves...)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (First, I will research online, and then gather materials in the library. I also want to hear from someone knowledgeable... which means, perhaps Digital-san?)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: (...This looks like it will take quite a bit of effort. But—)

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...She placed her expectations on me. Living up to them is what makes one first-class, is it not?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Tannhauser-san... I somehow managed to make that fuzzball cute...

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? King-chan!? Why do you look so pale!? Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Never mind me... just take what you requested.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: This is... Oooooh!? Guutara is wearing a cool suit!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Yes. I intentionally dressed it in mismatched clothes, styling it around the theme of "a monster trying to look dapper is cute."

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: To begin with, figures are already complete the moment they are purchased. Therefore—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I added elements to weave a "story." If you imagine he is heading out on a date and wearing an unfitting suit for it, doesn't it seem charming?

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaah... That's amazing, King-chan! Yeah, it turned out super duper cute!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! In the hands of King, something of this caliber is a breeze, utter child's play!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: You didn't give up and worked so hard... That's the only reason it could turn out this cute!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'm so happy! I can't stop grinning! —Thank you so, so much, King-chan!
One day, I came across Machikane Tannhauser handing a present to King Halo.

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Here you go, King-chan! This is a thank-you gift for the other day. Please take it!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes. Thank you, Tannhauser-san. Umm, well... how should I put this...
King Halo seems at a loss for words after receiving such a unique present. As a helping hand, I should say—
King Halo seems at a loss for words after receiving such a unique present. As a helping hand, I should say—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, precisely! This little one is so cute! Especially the jagged teeth!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, right? I'm so glad King-chan appreciates its cuteness too.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: O-Of course! In fact, I perceive nothing but absolute cuteness!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...You certainly saved me there. Allow me to offer my thanks. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes, indeed! Those sharp teeth are especially cool!

text_block_list.name: Machikane Tannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eh... cool? Hmm, really...? I always thought this guy was more cute than cool, though.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: ...T-That's right, it's not cool at all! Do not say such absurd things!
...Even though I tried to throw her a lifeline, she threw me under the bus without hesitation...!
